lines.text: Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of God Most High, blessed Abraham, who gave him a tenth of everything.
The law has Levi's priestly sons collect a tenth from the people, but Melchizedek collected a tenth from Abraham.
The writer asks why another priest was needed, one in Melchizedek's order and not in the order of Moses.
Our Lord descended from the tribe of Benjamin, a tribe as to which Moses said nothing about priests.
Many other priests died in office, but Jesus lives forever, has a permanent priesthood, and always lives to intercede.
